_readme: Config of tools/gen_rp_ladder.py: the pack's Raspberry Pie diet ladder (plan_rp_standalone.md P7, D10;
plan_food_diversity_1121.md section 7). The effects and their order are rp_ladder.csv next to this file.
densityRatio: effects per diversity point at the start of the unlockable and permanent sub-ladders divided by
the same at their end (density falls linearly; 1.0 = evenly spaced). Endpoints stay fixed.
unlockables / permanent: first and last threshold; count = the CSV's positions (checked).
hearts: count rungs of amount health points (2 = one heart) at top/(count+1) steps (the gap after the last
equals the gap before the first). pairs: armor toughness + knockback resistance at those fractions of top.
slots: count effect slots, evenly spaced from first in steps of (top - first)/count.
decimals: thresholds are rounded to this many places.
